newsitem.title: USA: No date announced for special meeting - Giddings.
newsitem.headline: No date announced for special meeting - Giddings.

text.p: Giddings & Lewis Inc said Tuesday it has not yet announced the date of a special shareholders meeting, which Harnischfeger Industries Inc is seeking as part of its hostile bid for Giddings.
"We have not announced it yet," Giddings spokeswoman Patricia Meinecke said. "We will be announcing (the date) as appropriate."
Earlier today, Harnischfeger, which has launched a $19 a share hostile bid for Giddings, said the special shareholders meeting must be held on September 5.
Harnischfeger based the date on its reading of Giddings's bylaws.

"Giddings & Lewis is well aware of the requirements of our bylaws and our duty to shareholders," Meinecke said, reading a statement from her company. "We have been deliberate and diligent in following our bylaws as well as in fulfilling our duty to shareholders and will continue to be so."
Giddings also said it was "well aware" of the advance notice required for the special shareholders meeting.
"By our calculations we have sufficient time to notify shareholders of the special meeting record date," Meinecke said.
Harnischfeger said the special shareholders meeting, which it requested in late May, would be held to remove and replace Giddings's board, among other things.
Giddings has rejected Harnischfeger's takeover bid as inadequate.
